title: Anyone else just stop having mall world dreams?
content: I had dreams about my local mall world regularly as a kid but they stopped sometime in my teenage years. Has anyone else had this experience or been successful in going back? "My" mall world consisted of a long hallway under my local mall. I would enter the mall at night when it was empty and somehow end up under it in this plain white hallway with doors lining it and each door opened to different room. A few were consistent (one giant room with a domed floor and huge versions of regular toys, and a door that opened into a cozy living room where an old couple would sit in a pair of chairs watching TV. They'd always ask me how I was and invite me in but I always told them I had more exploring to do and never stayed with them long). I made it to the very end once and opened the door and found a very dingy public bathroom/locker room type space but was warned by an old lady that there was a monster in there who'd eat my hair which I know is bizarre but I wasn't about to find out for myself so I turned back and never went to the end of the hallway again.
